meta.orientation: p_* = probability that A wins (A = first-named fighter in the card)
meta.market_open: fightodds.io per-book opening lines (sportsbooks), Shin no-vig, logit-mean (latest read; market_open_first_read keeps the first)
meta.first_capture: first pre-start snapshot that had lines for the bout
meta.last_pre_start: last snapshot taken before the bout started: the closing-line proxy for the forward test (hours_before_start says how close to the bell it was)
meta.archived_close: first snapshot taken after the scheduled start: the books' archived closing lines as BFO/fightodds keep them (exchanges may be in-play or settled; use p_consensus / p_meandec_mult, which exclude exchanges)
meta.use: forward-test benchmark; never a training feature for 2026 fights
